title: Building a physics-first GT3 browser game with Claude Code. Still torn on how realistic the scenery should be. Low poly or texture?
author: timcorin
selftext:
I'm working on Attimo Racing with Claude Code, a physics-first GT3 game you can play in your browser. The driving is the main focus, but I'm going back and forth on how far to take the scenery.



The cities have this white architectural-model look at the moment. Would you keep that, or texture the buildings? And do the low-poly trees suit it, or would more realistic ones make the whole thing feel better? You can see overall its somewhere in teh middle as I'm on the fence. 



There's a sponsor and team livery system in there too, which I'm curious to see how it lands as a concept. Instead of tuning, sponsors give you subtle benefits. Quite happy with how it's coming together, just keen to get some fresh eyes on it.



free to play at [https://attimoracing.io](https://attimoracing.io)
